name: Ernest Rutherford
summary: New Zealand-born physicist and chemist, Nobel laureate known for nuclear transmutation and discovery of radon.

name: Friedrich Ernst Dorn
summary: German physicist and professor at Friedrichs Universität, Halle, often credited with radon discovery.

name: Frederick Soddy
summary: English chemist who collaborated with Rutherford at McGill University on radioactive transformations.

name: Marie Curie
summary: Polish-French physicist and chemist who researched radioactivity and radium emanation.

name: McGill University
summary: Canadian university in Montreal where Rutherford performed his emanation research.

name: Manchester University
summary: English university where Rutherford worked from 1907 to 1918.

name: Cambridge University
summary: English university where Rutherford worked from 1919 to 1937.

name: Friedrichs Universität
summary: German university in Halle (Saale) where Dorn conducted his radium emanation studies.

name: Radon
summary: Radioactive gaseous element (Rn-222) discovered through emanation studies.

name: Nobel Prize
summary: Chemistry Nobel Prize awarded to Rutherford for investigations into disintegration of elements.
